cards.title: Full Stack Developer with BE Focus
cards.description: This role is for a true full-stack engineer, not just a frontend developer who connects to an API. The ideal candidate is backend-strong, confident on the frontend, and able to design and build systems from scratch.

vacancyDetails.roleDescription:
We are looking for a Full Stack Developer (Middle / Senior) to join our team on a part-time or full-time basis.

What we are looking for:
- Strong knowledge of both backend and frontend development
- Backend-first mindset, with the ability to work confidently on the frontend
- Solid architectural thinking
- Ability to design and build systems from scratch
- Experience in laying a strong foundation and planning for future extensibility
- Understanding of clean architecture, scalability, and maintainability

Requirements:
- React.js (4+ years), Next.js (2+ years), TypeScript (4+ years). Bonus if you know React Native.
- Supabase (1.5+ years) and GraphQL or REST APIs.
- PostgreSQL (3+ years) - strong knowledge beyond ORM level (queries, indexing, performance, data modeling).
- Bonus if you know Node.js, Nest.js, Express.js.
- Language requirements: Conversational English is required (B1). Ukrainian (B2) and Russian (B2).

If you enjoy building well-architected systems, thinking beyond just implementation, and owning features end-to-end, we’d be happy to talk.

cards.title: Frontend Developer (React, Next.js)
cards.description: This role is for an engineer who can build reliable, scalable frontend applications — not just implement designs page by page. We are looking for someone who understands application architecture, performance, reusable components, and how the frontend interacts with the entire system.

vacancyDetails.roleDescription:
We are looking for a Frontend Developer (Middle / Senior) to join our team on a part-time or full-time basis.

This role is for an engineer who can build reliable, scalable frontend applications — not just implement designs page by page. We are looking for someone who understands application architecture, performance, reusable components, and how the frontend interacts with the entire system.

Technical Requirements
- React
- Next.js
- TypeScript / JavaScript
- Strong knowledge of modern frontend architecture
- Experience working with REST and/or GraphQL APIs
- State management and data fetching
- Responsive and adaptive UI development
- Understanding of frontend performance and optimization
- Experience building reusable components and scalable UI systems

Bonus if you know
- Supabase
- React Native
- Testing frameworks
- CI/CD and deployment workflows

What we are looking for
- Strong frontend development skills
- Ability to build applications from scratch
- Good architectural thinking
- Understanding of clean, scalable, and maintainable code
- Ability to work independently and own features end-to-end
- Attention to UI/UX details
- Ability to collaborate with backend developers, designers, QA, and product teams

Level
Middle to Senior Frontend Developer
This is a frontend-focused role, but understanding how backend systems and APIs work is important.

Language
Conversational English is required (spoken and written).

If you enjoy building scalable frontend applications, thinking beyond individual components, and owning features from idea to production, we’d be happy to talk.

cards.title: Backend Developer (Supabase, PostgreSQL, Node.js)
cards.description: This role is for a backend-focused engineer who can design and build reliable systems from scratch. We are looking for someone comfortable making architectural decisions, designing databases and APIs, solving performance problems, and preparing systems for future growth.

vacancyDetails.roleDescription:
We are looking for a Backend Developer (Middle / Senior) to join our team on a part-time or full-time basis.

This role is for a backend-focused engineer who can design and build reliable systems from scratch. We are looking for someone comfortable making architectural decisions, designing databases and APIs, solving performance problems, and preparing systems for future growth.

Technical Requirements
- Supabase
- PostgreSQL — strong knowledge beyond ORM level
- Database design and data modeling
- SQL queries, indexing, query optimization, and performance
- REST APIs and/or GraphQL
- Authentication and authorization
- Row Level Security and permission models
- Backend integrations with external APIs and services

Bonus if you know
- Node.js
- TypeScript
- Supabase Edge Functions
- Background jobs / scheduled processes
- Webhooks and event-driven integrations
- Cloud infrastructure and CI/CD

What we are looking for
- Strong backend engineering skills
- Solid understanding of database architecture
- Ability to design APIs and systems from scratch
- Experience solving scalability and performance issues
- Understanding of security and access control
- Ability to make architectural decisions with future extensibility in mind
- Ability to independently own backend features from design to production

Level
Middle to Senior Backend Developer
This is a backend-focused role. Frontend knowledge is a plus but not required.

Language
Conversational English is required (spoken and written).

If you enjoy designing reliable backend systems, working deeply with databases, and solving architectural problems rather than only implementing endpoints, we’d be happy to talk.

cards.title: QA Engineer
cards.description: We are looking for someone who thinks beyond simply checking whether a feature works. The ideal candidate understands the product, identifies risks and edge cases, helps improve development processes, and takes responsibility for product quality.

vacancyDetails.roleDescription:
We are looking for a QA Engineer (Middle / Senior) to join our team on a part-time or full-time basis.

We are looking for someone who thinks beyond simply checking whether a feature works. The ideal candidate understands the product, identifies risks and edge cases, helps improve development processes, and takes responsibility for product quality throughout the development lifecycle.

Technical Requirements
- Strong experience with web application testing
- Functional and regression testing
- API testing
- Cross-browser and responsive testing
- Understanding of client-server architecture
- Ability to work with browser developer tools
- Experience testing REST APIs and/or GraphQL
- Ability to create clear test cases, checklists, and bug reports
- Understanding of databases and ability to validate data when necessary

Bonus if you know
- Postman
- SQL / PostgreSQL
- Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar automation tools
- JavaScript / TypeScript
- CI/CD pipelines
- Performance testing
- Supabase

What we are looking for
- Strong analytical and critical thinking
- Ability to identify edge cases before they reach production
- Understanding of business requirements, not only technical specifications
- Ability to investigate issues and help identify root causes
- Clear communication with developers, product managers, and designers
- Ownership of quality across the full feature lifecycle
- Ability to improve QA processes as the product grows

Level
Middle to Senior QA Engineer
Experience with both manual and automated testing is highly appreciated.

Language
Conversational English is required (spoken and written).

If you enjoy understanding how systems work, finding problems before users do, and helping teams build more reliable products, we’d be happy to talk.

cards.title: Python Developer (ML + AI)
cards.description: This role is for an engineer who can build real AI-powered products and backend systems — not just experiment with prompts or connect an application to an LLM API.

vacancyDetails.roleDescription:
We are looking for a Python Developer with ML / AI experience (Middle / Senior) to join our team on a part-time or full-time basis.

This role is for an engineer who can build real AI-powered products and backend systems — not just experiment with prompts or connect an application to an LLM API.
The ideal candidate has strong Python engineering skills, understands modern AI/ML technologies, and can design production-ready solutions with scalability, reliability, cost, and maintainability in mind.

Python / Backend Requirements
- Python
- Strong software engineering fundamentals
- Experience building backend services and APIs
- FastAPI, Django, Flask, or similar frameworks
- REST APIs
- PostgreSQL and SQL
- Integration with external APIs and services
- Background and asynchronous processing

AI / ML Requirements
- Experience integrating modern LLMs into production applications
- OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or similar APIs
- Prompt design and structured outputs
- RAG architectures
- Embeddings and vector search
- Understanding of LLM context management and token usage
- Experience working with AI pipelines and data processing
- Understanding of AI output evaluation and reliability

Bonus if you know
- LangChain / LangGraph / LlamaIndex or similar frameworks
- pgvector or other vector databases
- Hugging Face
- PyTorch
- Traditional machine learning
- Fine-tuning
- AI agents and tool-calling architectures
- Supabase
- Docker
- Cloud infrastructure and CI/CD

What we are looking for
- Strong Python development skills
- Ability to turn AI prototypes into production-ready systems
- Understanding of when to use AI and when traditional software approaches are better
- Ability to design AI systems from scratch
- Strong architectural thinking
- Understanding of scalability, performance, security, and cost optimization
- Ability to evaluate and improve the quality of AI outputs
- Ability to own features and systems end-to-end

Level
Middle to Senior Python / AI Developer
This is an engineering-focused AI role, not a prompt-engineering-only position.

Language
Conversational English is required (spoken and written).

If you enjoy building production AI systems, experimenting with modern ML technologies, and turning AI capabilities into reliable products, we’d be happy to talk.
